definitions.explanation: Extremely intense, severe, or violent; exceeding normal limits in a way that inspires awe or fear.

examples.japanese: すさまじい⟦{勢|いきお}い→勢い：01782_ikioi⟧だった。
すさまじい⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げられた→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧。
⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧すさまじさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: I was speechless at the ferocity of the explosion.

notes:
すさまじい describes something so extreme or intense that it inspires awe, fear, or disbelief. It carries a stronger and more literary tone than ⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧.

FORMS:
- すさまじく (adverbial): すさまじく⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧ (terrifyingly fast)
- すさまじさ (noun form): ⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧すさまじさ (the ferocity of the explosion)

WRITING:
Can be written as {凄|すさ}まじい, though hiragana is more common in modern usage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- すさまじい⟦{勢|いきお}い→勢い：01782_ikioi⟧: tremendous force/momentum
- すさまじい⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧: fierce competition
- すさまじい⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧: tremendous noise
- すさまじい{破壊力|はかいりょく}: devastating destructive power

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧: amazing, terrible (more casual, wider range of use)
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: intense, violent (often for weather, emotions, movement)
- ⟦{猛烈|もうれつ}→猛烈：13490_mouretsu⟧: fierce, furious (more formal, often in writing)

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: すさまじくなかったら
